tools.name: create_key
tools.description: Create a scoring key (no signup). One key covers all agents, identified by OTel service.name. webhook_url (https) is optional but recommended: it receives an HMAC-signed POST when any agent's score changes band.

tools.name: get_scores
tools.description: Current drift score per agent under the key: 0-39 deviating, 40-69 watch, 70-100 normal; status 'learning' until the 30-run baseline freezes.

tools.name: set_webhook
tools.description: Add or change the https webhook notified on band changes.

tools.name: revoke_key
tools.description: Revoke the key and permanently delete all data stored under it. Requires confirm=true.
